title: Committee of Supply debate on transport spending and policy
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head W of the Estimates, opened by Ms Tin Pei Ling moving a $100 reduction, followed by Member speeches and ministerial clarifications on transport policy.
why_it_matters: The transcript records a transport spending debate covering airport and port expansion, EV charging, autonomous vehicles, rail timelines, bus connectivity, road safety and COE reform. The only formal action is the withdrawal of the proposed $100 reduction in Head W, so the record does not show a spending change taking effect. The record does not set out the practical impact of the proposals beyond the stated questions and ministerial responses.

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling moved that the total sum allocated to Head W of the Estimates be reduced by $100.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
key_points.quote: That the total sum allocated to Head W of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling said the Government Parliamentary Committee for Transport plans to move a substantive Motion later this year, likely in July.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
key_points.quote: the Government Parliamentary Committee (GPC) for Transport plans to move a substantive Motion later this year, likely in July.

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling asked for an update on the current status of T5 and the Tuas port development.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
key_points.quote: Can the Ministry update the House on the current status of T5 and the Tuas port development?

key_points.point: Mr Sharael Taha said T5 adds capacity of 15 million passengers annually and the Changi East Industrial Zone expands cargo from three to 5.4 million tonnes annually.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: T5 adding capacity of 15 million passengers annually, and the Changi East Industrial Zone expanding cargo from three to 5.4 million tonnes annually

key_points.point: Ms Poh Li San said Changi Airport will increase its capacity by another 50 million passengers per annum when T5 is ready around the middle of next decade.
key_points.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
key_points.quote: Changi Airport will increase its capacity by another 50 million passengers per annum when T5 is ready around the middle of next decade.

key_points.point: Ms Poh Li San said CAAS announced a 200 million One Aviation Manpower Fund in July 2025.
key_points.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
key_points.quote: In July 2025, the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) announced a 200 million One Aviation Manpower Fund to attract, develop and retain the aviation workforce.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo Wan Ling asked where liability lies in the event of an autonomous vehicle malfunction or incident.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
key_points.quote: In the event of a malfunction or incident, where does liability lie?

key_points.point: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis said LTA plans to procure six autonomous buses with operations beginning in mid-2026 for an initial period of three years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: the Land Transport Authority (LTA) plans to procure six autonomous buses with operations beginning in mid-2026 for an initial period of three years.

key_points.point: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis said Singapore currently has around 28,300 charging points.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: Singapore currently has around 28,300 charging points.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong asked what peak-hour utilisation threshold triggers installation of additional chargers in HDB car parks.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: What is the specific peak-hour utilisation threshold that triggers the installation of additional chargers in HDB car park?

key_points.point: Mr Ang Wei Neng urged LTA to spearhead the deployment of more fast chargers within HDB estates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
key_points.quote: I therefore urge LTA to spearhead the deployment of more fast chargers within the HDB estates

key_points.point: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song said LTA needs to reinforce that pedestrians always have the right of way.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
key_points.quote: LTA needs to reinforce that pedestrians always have the right of way.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim asked the Ministry to review how bus layout can better cater to commuters with mobility issues.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: Could the Ministry review how the layout of buses can better cater to commuters with such mobility issues?

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim said lift works at overhead bridges along Hougang Avenue 3 will only commence tentatively in the third quarter of 2027.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: the lift works will only commence tentatively in the third quarter of 2027.

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong said 176 residents at Parc Vera Condominium submitted a petition in July 2025 for an 80-metre covered walkway.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
key_points.quote: In July 2025, 176 residents at Parc Vera Condominium at Hougang Street 32, submitted a petition for 80 metres covered walkway

key_points.point: Ms Elysa Chen asked what further measures are planned to make buses and trains more inclusive for young families and persons with disabilities.
key_points.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen
key_points.quote: Can the Ministry share what further measures are planned to make buses and trains more inclusive for young families and persons with disabilities?

key_points.point: Miss Rachel Ong asked whether visual and sign language communication tools will be expanded for deaf commuters across the public transport system.
key_points.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
key_points.quote: Could the Government update whether visual and sign language communication tools will be expanded so that disruption and emergency announcements are accessible to deaf commuters across our public transport system?

key_points.point: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre urged the Government to incorporate provisions for express rail services on the Seletar Line from the outset.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I urge the Government to incorporate provisions for express rail services on the Seletar Line from the outset

key_points.point: Ms Poh Li San said the Rapid Transit System to Johor is expected to open by the end of this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
key_points.quote: by the end of this year, the Rapid Transit System (RTS) to Johor is expected to open.

key_points.point: Mr Ang Wei Neng asked whether Circle Line Stage 6 will open in the second quarter of this year as earlier announced.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
key_points.quote: whether the Circle Line Stage 6, linking HarbourFront to Marina Bay via Keppel, Cantonment and Prince Edward Road stations will open in the second quarter of this year, as earlier announced.

key_points.point: Mr Sharael Taha said the Rail Reliability Taskforce has set out recommendations on renewal, resilience, asset management, workforce capabilities and commuter communications.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: the Rail Reliability Taskforce has set out clear recommendations – accelerate renewal of ageing core systems, including train signalling and traction power, strengthen backup and resilience measures, improve asset management and spare part planning, deepen workforce capabilities and enhance commuter communications during disruptions.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo Wan Ling said starting basic salaries for new bus captains remain around $2,250 per month.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
key_points.quote: starting basic salaries for new entrants remain around $2,250 per month.

key_points.point: Ms Yeo Wan Ling said half of the public bus fleet is expected to be electric by 2030.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
key_points.quote: half of our public bus fleet is expected to be electric by 2030.

key_points.point: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik renewed his call for LTA to reconsider bus connectivity for Compassvale Crescent residents.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
key_points.quote: I therefore renew my call for LTA to reconsider this matter

key_points.point: Ms Valerie Lee asked whether the Ministry can move beyond relying heavily on retrospective ridership data when refining bus service plans.
key_points.speaker: Ms Valerie Lee
key_points.quote: can the Ministry move beyond relying heavily on retrospective ridership data when refining bus service plans?

key_points.point: Mr Liang Eng Hwa said traffic congestion in Singapore has visibly worsened.
key_points.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
key_points.quote: traffic congestion in Singapore has visibly worsened.

key_points.point: Mr Jackson Lam asked whether MOT has considered adopting elements of a Vision Zero approach tailored to Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jackson Lam
key_points.quote: has MOT considered adopting elements of a Vision Zero approach tailored to Singapore

key_points.point: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui said the COE framework could evolve from separate Cat A and Cat B categories towards an OMV-based model with a single bidding pool.
key_points.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
key_points.quote: the COE framework could evolve from separate Cat A and Cat B categories towards an OMV-based model with a single bidding pool.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said ERP is not the first option by any means.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: ERP is not our first option by any means.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said using AI for systems such as traffic light management would significantly improve traffic fluidity.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: using AI for systems, such as traffic light management, would significantly improve the fluidity of our traffic.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said EMAS takes about an average of 15 minutes to clear jams or an accident on the highway.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: they take about an average of 15 minutes to clear jams or clear an accident on the highway

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said the baseline deployment was at least three charging points per HDB car park.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: We started with a baseline deployment of at least three charging points per HDB car park.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said the first phase of upgrades would benefit around 450 HDB multi-storey car parks and is expected to complete by around 2029.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: we have kickstarted our first phase of upgrades, which would benefit around 450 HDB multi-storey car parks and this upgrade is expected to complete by around 2029.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow confirmed the Government will look at an OMV-based system and merging Cat A and Cat B in a single-bidding category.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: I do confirm that indeed we will look specifically at Mr Chia's suggestion, which is to look at a system that is OMV-based, but also to look at merging Cat A and Cat B in a single-bidding category.

key_points.point: Mr Murali Pillai said the maritime sector has not participated in the GRIT programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
key_points.quote: for the maritime sector, we have not participated in the GRIT programme.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said autonomous buses will launch in two areas in the second half of this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: we will launch those I think in the second half of this year.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said the Vehicle Entry Permit fee will be raised substantially from 2027 onwards.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: we are going to raise the fee substantially from 2027 onwards.

key_points.point: Mr Jeffrey Siow said the intent is to deploy as many double decker buses as possible.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
key_points.quote: our intent is to try to deploy as many double decker buses as possible.

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said additional road or lane closures needed during certain phases of work will be carried out during off peak periods.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: additional road or lane closures which are needed during certain phases of work will be carried out during off peak periods

key_points.point: Mr Baey Yam Keng said the Caring Commuters' movement exists.
key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: we have the Caring Commuters' movement.

key_points.point: Mr Baey Yam Keng said upcoming condominium developments with more than 700 dwelling units within 400 metres of an MRT station are required to submit walk-cycle-ride plans, and URA will work with LTA to impose covered linkway requirements where needed.
key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: for upcoming condominium developments with more than 700 dwelling units and are located within 400 metres of a MRT station, developers are already required to submit walk-cycle-ride plans as part of the development application process.

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling withdrew her amendment.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
key_points.quote: I beg leave to withdraw my amendment.

what_happens_next: Ms Tin Pei Ling withdrew her amendment. She said the GPC for Transport plans to move a substantive Motion later this year, likely in July. Other stated future steps include autonomous buses launching in the second half of this year, RTS to Johor expected to open by the end of this year, VEP fee raised substantially from 2027, and first phase of HDB car park electrical upgrades expected to complete by around 2029.
